authoritySource: Public Holidays Act (Cap. 110), Schedule Part I and section 4, Kenya Law revised text as at 2024-04-26 (https://new.kenyalaw.org/akn/ke/act/1912/21/eng@2024-04-26). Fixed-date list confirmed by the product owner on 2026-11-01.
applicability: All employers in Kenya. Generates the fixed-date public holidays of Part I of the Schedule. Movable Part I holidays (Good Friday, Easter Monday, Idd-ul-Fitr) and Part II/III holidays are not generated: administrators add them per year as gazetted, as they do for days declared by Gazette notice under section 3.

sundayRule.source: Public Holidays Act (Cap. 110), section 4: where a Part I day falls on a Sunday, the first succeeding day that is not a public holiday is a public holiday instead.

notGenerated.name: Idd-ul-Fitr
notGenerated.note: Date depends on the moon; declared by Gazette notice. Add when announced. Section 4 also applies if it falls on a Sunday.
